baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated ء م ن at words 3 and 9, followed by مَنْ ءَامَنَ ... وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا at words 8-14.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah first names plural communities, then reopens the roster with singular مَنْ and repeats belief as a criterion completed by intentional repair. The second occurrence tests rather than merely echoes the first label, while the plural outcome gathers whoever passes that test.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settling assent supplies both the opening label and the repeated criterion, so recurrence turns nominal belonging into tested trust.
Purposeful action carries assent out of naming and into intended conduct.
صلاح as the opposite of فساد makes the required conduct reparative rather than merely busy.

changed_reading.before: The ayah assigns one undifferentiated status to four inherited communities.
changed_reading.after: The four names are passed through one repeatable criterion: settled assent must become purposeful, repairing action before the promise attaches.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: بِٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْءَاخِرِ ... فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The later or final day extends the horizon ahead; fear anticipates marked harm, while grief roughens the self under loss. Their paired negation gives the security branch of faith a two-sided temporal form: no domination by what may come and no continuing abrasion from what has been lost.

activation_trace.role: Settled security links the repeated faith language directly to the later removal of fear.
A bounded duration of time supplies the horizon across which the affective promise operates.
Laterness after what is first pushes the ayah beyond present communal position toward ultimate outcome.
Expected harm supplies the prospective pole that the promise removes.
The roughness of the self under grief supplies the lingering pole that the promise removes.

changed_reading.before: No fear and no grief is a generic formula of comfort.
changed_reading.after: The promise reorganizes both temporal directions around the final horizon: anticipated threat no longer rules the future, and grief no longer keeps the past rough within the self.

baseline_models.mechanism: The صالح branch joins freedom from فساد to صلح as removal of mutual aversion. Coupled with purposeful عمل, the criterion can therefore describe conduct that restores a damaged relation; the resulting absence of fear is relational safety as well as private reassurance.

activation_trace.role: Intentional doing makes repair an enacted mechanism rather than a favorable description.
Removal of aversion and dispute supplies the social operation inside صالح.
Release from expected harm is the safety produced or recognized when estrangement is repaired.

changed_reading.before: A generically good deed earns an individual reassurance.
changed_reading.after: Purposefully restoring what corruption or estrangement damaged is an operative good, and the promise names the protected relation opened by that repair.

context_deltas.mechanism: At 5:61 the spoken claim آمَنَّا coexists with entering in كفر, leaving with it, and concealment. Speech is therefore a surface that interior carriage can contradict. This sharpens the second ءامن in 5:69 into substantive, settled trust rather than a repeated profession.

activation_trace.role: The focus repetition asks for assent in which the heart can settle, not only a community name.
Uttered speech externalizes the belief claim and makes its surface character inspectable.
The same assent branch is explicitly claimed here, allowing the following movement to test it.
Passage into an interior gives the contradiction a directional, carried-through mechanism.
Blocking or covering truth names what is carried beneath the professed surface.
Concealment locates the decisive mismatch in an unseen interior rather than in vocabulary alone.

structural_cues: 5:61 places قَالُوا آمَنَّا before دَخَلُوا بِٱلْكُفْرِ and خَرَجُوا بِهِ.
The focus repeats ء م ن after the communal roster rather than relying on its opening occurrence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the contradiction among profession, passage, and concealment; I infer that the repeated focus verb tests actuality. A live alternative is that 5:61 diagnoses a local mismatch without defining every use of ءامن.

changed_reading.before: The second belief clause restates the profession already present in the first group name.
changed_reading.after: The second belief clause screens every listed identity, including a verbal profession, for trust that has actually settled and directs conduct.

context_deltas.mechanism: The lead-in gives social damage momentum: people accelerate into obstruction of good, exceed limits, consume what strips life away, and are not restrained. It then images conflict as fire repeatedly extinguished and names فساد. Against that chain, عمل صالح in 5:69 becomes deliberate counter-motion that arrests, restrains, extinguishes, and repairs.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful doing supplies the agency required to interrupt the damaging sequence.
The opposite of فساد supplies the focus phrase's exact counter-state.
Speed gives wrongdoing momentum, making صالح an intervention in a moving process.
Delay from good identifies what the accelerated movement is functionally producing.
Crossing the limit supplies the breach that repair must reverse.
Stripping or eradication gives illicit consumption a material effect on communal integrity.
Restraint is the missing social brake, supplying one concrete operation of reparative action.
Cooling flame and ember supplies an explicit reversal of an escalating conflict mechanism.
Departure from sound order names the condition to which focus صالح is the direct lexical counter.

structural_cues: 5:62-63 repeats illicit speech or consumption and contrasts doing with leaders' failure to restrain it.
5:64 moves from enmity and hatred to repeatedly kindled war, extinguishing, and فساد immediately before the focus sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies acceleration, consumption, absent restraint, extinguishing, and فساد; I supply the arrow that صالح gathers these into a counter-process. A live alternative is that صالح remains a broad individual category and the social mechanism is only a contextual specification.

changed_reading.before: عمل صالح means adding unspecified good deeds to belief.
changed_reading.after: عمل صالح means entering the active counter-process to social corrosion: slow transgression, refuse stripping consumption, restrain wrongdoing, extinguish conflict, and restore sound order.

context_deltas.mechanism: At 5:66, making received texts stand is followed by provision from above and below; 5:68 repeats the establishment demand immediately before the focus. The standing, tending, and straightening branches of ق و م revise صالح from isolated moral acts toward sustained maintenance that makes guidance operative and opens a whole provision system.

activation_trace.role: Standing over an assigned work lets action include durable responsibility and administration.
Restored soundness is the maintained state, not merely the momentary deed.
Care, preservation, and charge turn إقامة into sustained operational custody.
What has been delivered supplies the material that must be made operative rather than merely possessed.
Consumable share and sustenance renders the result of maintained guidance as lived provision.
The upper direction marks one boundary of a provision field surrounding the community.
The lower direction completes the surrounding field, making the consequence systemic rather than isolated.

structural_cues: 5:65 conditions covering and entry into gardens on belief and guarding.
5:66 links إقامة of received texts to eating from above and below.
5:68 repeats تُقِيمُوا immediately before 5:69 supplies وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies establishment, received material, and surrounding provision; I infer that the adjacent صالح includes making guidance stand in communal life. A live alternative is that إقامة remains a community-specific demand and does not define صالح generally.

changed_reading.before: The focus asks for detached instances of moral goodness.
changed_reading.after: The focus can ask for maintained, responsible practice that makes received guidance stand, restoring a social and material order in which provision can circulate.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later context places divergent responses around the same Christian label. 5:72-73 rejects joining partners to God and asserts divine oneness; 5:82 names نَصَارَى, then 5:83-85 traces hearing, recognition, belief, desire for the صالح community, and recompense. The focus condition therefore cuts within a label according to response rather than issuing a blanket verdict on the label.

activation_trace.role: The Christian community name anchors the focus category whose internal divergence the later sequence displays.
Settled assent supplies the criterion by which responses inside the category diverge.
Association with God supplies a rejected response located within the surrounding Christian discourse.
Divine oneness without partner supplies the contrastive content of belief in God.
The same community designation reappears before a receptive sequence, preventing the name alone from deciding status.
Hearing as understanding and compliance starts the positive response as reception rather than inherited possession.
Recognition by a distinguishing mark turns reception into discernment of truth.
Their explicit assent instantiates the repeated focus criterion after hearing and recognition.
Seeking entry among the صالحين carries the focus's reparative quality into communal belonging.
A deed met by its recompense closes the sequence with the outcome implied by the focus promise.

structural_cues: 5:72-73 and 5:82-85 place sharply different responses within one extended Christian discourse.
5:83-85 orders hearing, recognition, avowed belief, desired صالح company, and recompense.
The focus's مَنْ construction can gather persons across named plurals while still discriminating among their responses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the shared label and opposed response sequences; I infer that 5:82-85 concretely instantiates the condition in 5:69. A live alternative is that the later group is only a praised subset and is adjacent illustration rather than an exposition of the focus.

changed_reading.before: Naming Christians in the roster either includes or excludes the confession as a whole.
changed_reading.after: The ayah refuses a blanket confessional verdict: the same label can contain opposed responses, and hearing, recognition, settled belief, and alignment with repair determine where the promise lands.

context_deltas.mechanism: The receptive sequence after the focus contains worship shaped by awe, eyes overflowing with tears, and hope for entry. Because these affects occur on the positive trajectory, no fear and no grief cannot mean emotional anesthesia. It removes the rule of anticipated harm and abrasive sorrow while leaving responsive awe, tears, and hope alive.

activation_trace.role: Threat-expectation identifies the constrictive fear that is negated.
Roughening grief identifies the abiding damage that is negated.
Worship arising from awe shows that a fear-related posture can remain responsive rather than threat-dominated.
Easy abundant overflow makes the positive response dynamically affective rather than numb.
Tears and their channel embody emotion that accompanies recognition without being equated with condemned grief.
Hope in the heart supplies a future-facing affect that replaces fearful expectation rather than abolishing expectation.

structural_cues: 5:82-84 places humble worship, overflowing tears, and hope on the praised response path.
5:83 explicitly ties the tears to recognition of truth, while 5:84 turns that response toward hoped-for entry.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies positive tears and hope; I infer that these are not the خوف and حزن negated in the focus but transformed modes of response. A live alternative is that the tears include sorrow, so the distinction is functional rather than a strict taxonomy of emotions.

changed_reading.before: The promise eliminates painful or intense feeling.
changed_reading.after: The promise eliminates subjection to anticipated harm and grinding sorrow, not affective responsiveness: recognition may still overflow in tears, awe may orient worship, and hope may face the future.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because هادوا and نصارى are lexicalized community names, and the packet's split mapping of ه و د is form-distant. It remains anchored to focus words 5 and 7 and to their supplied branch inventories. Downstream prose should present it only as latent branch wordplay, not as a historical etymology or replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: هَادُوا at word 5 and ٱلنَّصَارَى at word 7 inside the named roster.

activation_trace.role: Gentle direction toward a path lets the community name cast a faint trajectory of being guided.
Aid that makes another prevail lets the community name cast a faint functional image of becoming support.
Security and trust provide the explicit orientation that the condition repeats and makes normative.

changed_reading.before: The roster is only a sequence of static inherited names.
changed_reading.after: At a contained latent level, the names also flicker as orientations toward security, direction, and aid; the repeated condition asks whether nominal affiliation becomes a lived function of trust and repair.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain activation is branch-distant: it links the focus's ن ص ر rain and water-channel images to provision scenes before and after the focus. It remains anchored to ٱلنَّصَارَى and عمل صالح plus explicit extension, spending, sustenance, and rivers. Downstream prose should qualify it as a material analogy for aid and repair, never as the lexical meaning of the community name.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: وَٱلنَّصَارَىٰ at word 7 and وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا at words 13-14.

activation_trace.role: Rain as aid supplies a material image of help arriving as life-bearing provision.
Channels coming from afar into gathered water supply the routing mechanism for that aid.
Repair against فساد supplies the reopening or preservation of a life-bearing circuit.
Extension against constriction opens the spatial capacity through which provision can move.
Outgoing expenditure supplies active release rather than hoarded capacity.
A consumable share renders the circulation as received sustenance.
Unimpeded running supplies the mature state of the restored flow.
A river cutting the earth with running water gives the provision circuit a final durable channel.

changed_reading.before: Aid, repair, and the final garden scene are unrelated themes.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, aid arrives like rain, repair keeps its channels open, and the promised outcome appears as provision moving freely all the way to running rivers.

strongest_changes: The repeated faith clause tests lived, settled trust against both inherited labels and verbal profession.
عمل صالح becomes an active counter-process to accelerated social corrosion and a maintained practice that makes guidance stand.
The later same-label contrast shows the condition cutting within communal identity through hearing, recognition, belief, and repair.
No fear and no grief removes domination by threat and abrasive sorrow without erasing awe, tears, or hope.
summary.what_was_special: The focus is a hinge: corrosive conduct and failed establishment before it specify what صالح must repair, while divergent Christian responses after it enact the distinction between a name and the repeated criterion. The packet's affective sequence then prevents the reassurance from collapsing into emotional numbness.
remaining_uncertainties: The direct use of 5:82-85 as an enactment of 5:69 is strongly sequential but remains a reader-supplied relation.
The reconciliation branch of صالح may be a secondary resonance rather than the governing sense of every صالح occurrence.
The trajectory and water-circulation outliers depend on deliberately contained branch play and should not control a final interpretation.
